messages.text: For a AI use case involving AI data centers, where would Oscilloscope fit in the test workflow?

An oscilloscope fits mainly in the AI data center **board/system power-validation part of the workflow**, especially around **server motherboard / PCBA** and **power-supply testing**, rather than in the VNA-led insertion-loss, TDR, or high-speed trace portions of the workflow.[23]
Its role is to measure and debug **power rail**, **multiphase DC**, and **power-integrity (PI)** behavior on server motherboard / PCBA designs, where the mapping lists **MXO** for “power rail / multiphase DC / PI.”[23] It also fits in the **AI data center power electronics** workflow for power-supply-related categories such as **HVDC, 5–10 kW PSU, liquid-cooled power cabinets, and BBU**, where **MXO** is again mapped to “power rail / multiphase DC / PI.”[23] For cooling-related subsystems, the same mapping places **MXO** in **motor driver analysis** for components such as rails, liquid-cooling plates, CDUs, and fans.[23]
【推論】So, in an AI data center test workflow, the oscilloscope is best positioned after or alongside power-design bring-up and validation: use it to verify rail quality, multiphase power behavior, PI issues, and cooling-system motor-drive behavior, while VNA instruments cover IL/TDR/high-speed trace or cable tests.[23]

[23] Wiki：AISeverEcosystem（來源：`AISeverEcosystem.md`）
